message.reasoning_content: This is a live medley? Likely a bootleg/live recording. "Don't Let Me Down" is Lennon–McCartney. Medley includes covers, but credited writing likely Lennon/McCartney. Hmm, ambiguous. Choose Lennon and McCartney, ~0.7.
